**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject unexpected redirects before auditing the page**

Against an auth-enabled server, fresh contexts have no session, so `requireAppRoute` in `src/lib/auth/app-route.ts` redirects protected routes to `/auth/v2/login`. For catalog entries without `ready`, such as `/dashboard/analytics`, the final login response can satisfy the HTTP, hydration and theme checks, and its axe results are then reported under the requested dashboard route. Recording `finalURL` without validating it allows an untested page to receive a passing report. Validate the destination before capture, with explicit expected destinations for intentional catalog aliases, and fail clearly when authentication prevents access.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve colons inside parenthesized utility values**

For a literal utility such as `text-(length:--my-font-size)`, the variant splitter treats the type-hint colon as a variant separator because it tracks only square brackets. The resulting candidate is `--my-font-size)`, so the arbitrary-value check silently accepts it even though the utility regex matches the original token. This bypasses the documented parenthesized typography-value restriction and its exception policy. Track parentheses as well when locating variant separators, and add a typed-parenthesis regression fixture.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include input-group controls in the mobile font-size override**

On mobile Safari, grouped inputs and textareas now fall from 16px to 14px and trigger focus zoom because this selector misses them. `InputGroupInput` and `InputGroupTextarea` in `src/components/ui/input-group.tsx` replace the underlying primitive’s slot with `data-slot="input-group-control"`, so they retain the newly reduced `text-base` size instead of receiving this override. This affects, for example, Mail search, the Finance transfer amount, and the Chat composer. Include the grouped-control slot in the mobile override to preserve their previous entry-text behavior.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve series labels in the sales tooltip formatter**

When hovering or keyboard-navigating the Sales Overview chart, the tooltip now shows two bare currency amounts without identifying Revenue versus Profit. `ChartTooltipContent` in `src/components/ui/chart.tsx` treats `formatter` as a replacement for the entire item row, including its series label and color indicator—not just its value. Return a labelled row from this callback so users can reliably associate each amount with its series.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Start the hydration delay when scripts become available**

If context setup and the initial document response take at least `hydrationDelayMs` (for example, during a cold dev-server start), this deadline expires before the browser requests any scripts. The interception then delivers every script without delay, allowing the advertised delayed-hydration check to pass without exercising hydration across a second boundary. Start the delay from the document response or first script interception, and reset it equivalently for refresh captures, so the required screenshot evidence actually tests the intended condition.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply project filters before limiting database results**

When a database contains more than 100 projects, `repository.projects()` returns only the first 100 before these status and search filters run. A matching project outside that initial batch therefore cannot be found by `readProjects`, even though `readProject` can retrieve it directly; filtering can return an empty result despite matching stored records. Pass the validated filters into the repository and apply them in SQL before the result limit.
